facts.text: Relatively untouched by galactic events, a battle was fought at Farstine in 19 BBY between Separatist holdout forces commanded by Trade Federation Customs Vizier Marath Vooro, and an Imperial fleet headed by the Imperial officer Octavian Grant.

evidence.quote: Relatively untouched by galactic events, a battle was fought at Farstine in 19 BBY between Separatist holdout forces commanded by Trade Federation Customs Vizier Marath Vooro, and an Imperial fleet headed by the Imperial officer Octavian Grant.

facts.text: The planet was known to be one of the spice trade's major transshipment hubs, and was under Imperial occupation at some point during the Galactic Civil War.

evidence.quote: The planet was known to be one of the spice trade's major transshipment hubs, and was under Imperial occupation at some point during the Galactic Civil War.

facts.text: Farstine was also located between the planets Zhar and Ryndellia on the Triellus Trade Route, a hyperlane that linked a swath of the Outer Rim contained within the Slice, skirting Hutt Space before turning into the Mid Rim and terminating at Enarc.

evidence.quote: Farstine was also located between the planets Zhar and Ryndellia on the Triellus Trade Route, a hyperlane that linked a swath of the Outer Rim contained within the Slice, skirting Hutt Space before turning into the Mid Rim and terminating at Enarc.

facts.text: Farstine had a methane atmosphere, and oxygen-breathing species required breath masks for survival.

facts.text: By 25 ABY, Farstine had a population numbering between 500 million to one billion inhabitants.

evidence.quote: By 25 ABY, Farstine had a population numbering between 500 million to one billion inhabitants.

facts.text: Farstine was discovered and settled sometime prior to the Cold War, an uneasy eleven-year period of peace between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire following the signing of the Treaty of Coruscant, which ended the Great Galactic War in 3653 BBY.

evidence.quote: Farstine was discovered and settled sometime prior to the Cold War, an uneasy eleven-year period of peace between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire following the signing of the Treaty of Coruscant, which ended the Great Galactic War in 3653 BBY.

facts.text: Over two thousand years later, during the New Sith Wars—which pitted the Republic against the Sith Brotherhood of Darkness between 1004 BBY and 1000 BBY—Farstine was located in disputed territory.

evidence.quote: Over two thousand years later, during the New Sith Wars—which pitted the Republic against the Sith Brotherhood of Darkness between 1004 BBY and 1000 BBY—Farstine was located in disputed territory.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars that raged from 22 BBY to 19 BBY, fought between the Republic and the breakaway separatists of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Farstine fell within Republic-controlled space.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars that raged from 22 BBY to 19 BBY, fought between the Republic and the breakaway separatists of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Farstine fell within Republic-controlled space.

facts.text: In 19 BBY, following the end of the Clone Wars, the victorious Republic was transformed into the Galactic Empire.

evidence.quote: In 19 BBY, following the end of the Clone Wars, the victorious Republic was transformed into the Galactic Empire.

facts.text: Seeking to bring various Separatist holdouts—including Vooro—to heel, the Empire launched a series of campaigns to reconquer the Outer Rim Territories.

evidence.quote: Seeking to bring various Separatist holdouts—including Vooro—to heel, the Empire launched a series of campaigns to reconquer the Outer Rim Territories.

facts.text: A fleet commanded by the Imperial officer Octavian Grant faced Vooro's forces at Farstine and defeated them, forcing Vooro to retreat down the Five Veils Route.

evidence.quote: A fleet commanded by the Imperial officer Octavian Grant faced Vooro's forces at Farstine and defeated them, forcing Vooro to retreat down the Five Veils Route.

facts.text: During the Galactic Civil War, which was fought between the Empire and the insurgent Alliance to Restore the Republic, Imperial forces occupied Farstine.

evidence.quote: During the Galactic Civil War, which was fought between the Empire and the insurgent Alliance to Restore the Republic, Imperial forces occupied Farstine.

facts.text: In 3 ABY, the Imperial Death Squadron used Farstine as a transit point en route from the Qeimet system to the Eriadu system.

facts.text: In 9 ABY, Imperial forces allied with Grand Admiral Thrawn passed by Farstine on route to Svivren, where they laid siege to the planet on 44:7:24 as part of Thrawn's campaign against the New Republic, the galactic government and successor state to the Alliance.

facts.text: Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim establishes that Farstine is the head of the Five Veils' Tour trade route, which linked Farstine to Skynara in the Skine sector.

evidence.quote: Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim establishes that Farstine is the head of the Five Veils' Tour trade route, which linked Farstine to Skynara in the Skine sector.

facts.text: In 2009's The Essential Atlas by Jason Fry and Daniel Wallace, no mention was made of the Five Veils' Tour trade route, but a Five Veils Route was included, linking Farstine to Svivren in the Svivreni sector.

evidence.quote: In 2009's The Essential Atlas by Jason Fry and Daniel Wallace, no mention was made of the Five Veils' Tour trade route, but a Five Veils Route was included, linking Farstine to Svivren in the Svivreni sector.

facts.text: In a thread on the Jedi Council Forums on TheForce.Net, Fry clarified that the Five Veils' Tour trade route and the Five Veils Route were the same hyperlane and that the differing destinations were a result of tourism and shipping companies setting different endpoints.

evidence.quote: In a thread on the Jedi Council Forums on TheForce.Net, Fry clarified that the Five Veils' Tour trade route and the Five Veils Route were the same hyperlane and that the differing destinations were a result of tourism and shipping companies setting different endpoints.

facts.text: Farstine's entry in The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia established that it was located in the Skine sector.

facts.text: While Skynara, the end point of the Five Veils Route, had been established to be located in the Skine sector in Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim, Farstine had not.
